name: Cristelle
title: Morrel Ocean Traders
description: The president of Morrel Ocean Traders, one of the largest trading companies around. A prominent figure in high society, famed for her eccentric manner.
introduction:
President of Morrel Ocean Traders, one of the largest trading companies on the continent. A woman shrouded in mystery.

Cristelle is forever smiling, but there is never any sincerity behind it. Even those who have served her longest swear they have never seen her smile in earnest. 

Only when teasing or trading jokes with her vice president, Haydee, does she occasionally reveal a smile unlike the one she usually wears.

Her hatred for Morcerf runs even deeper than Haydee's. Seeking the power to exact her revenge, she accepted the invitation to the Journey.
